assets.title: Self-Assessment: Nature of Financial Risk
assets.content: Q1. Define financial risk and give two examples of how it arises in a bank.
assets.solution: Q1. Financial risk is the possibility of loss from market, credit, liquidity, or operational exposure. Examples: a trading loss from market moves; a borrower default (credit).
